title: Full Stack Developer
description: Full-Stack Developer Arıyoruz! Yüksek performanslı, ölçeklenebilir ve dağıtık mikro servisler geliştirirken aynı zamanda modern frontend teknolojileriyle etkileşimli arayüzler oluşturmak ister misin? Takımımıza Full-Stack Developer olarak katılacak, modern teknolojilerle çalışmaya istekli ekip arkadaşları arıyoruz! Patrion İleri Teknoloji Sistemleri A.Ş. Hakkında Patrion İleri Teknoloji Sistemleri, 2020 yılında kurulmuş olup, endüstriyel otomasyon, yazılım ve ileri teknoloji çözümleri alanlarında faaliyette bulunmaktadır. İzmir’deki Ar-Ge merkezimiz ile yenilikçi teknolojiler geliştirerek işletmelere otomasyon, enerji yönetimi ve özelleştirilmiş yazılım çözümleri sunmaktayız. Teknolojiler ve Yetkinlikler Backend Teknolojileri: Python (Flask, FastAPI), Node.js (NestJS), GoLang ile API geliştirme Mikroservis mimarisi ve monolitik mimari tasarımı RESTful ve GraphQL API tasarımı, API Gateway yönetimi (Kong, Nginx, Traefik vb.), gRPC ile yüksek performanslı servis iletişimi WebSockets, Server-Sent Events (SSE) ile canlı veri akışı, event-driven mimariler Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis Streams, NATS.io ile mesajlaşma ve event-driven mimari OAuth2, JWT, API Rate Limiting, RBAC (Role-Based Access Control) ve ABAC (Attribute-Based Access Control) Frontend Teknolojileri: React.js ve Next.js ile dinamik ve etkileşimli web uygulamaları geliştirme Postman ve Swagger ile API entegrasyonlarını test etme WebSockets ve Socket.io kullanarak gerçek zamanlı iletişim altyapısı oluşturma Responsive ve performanslı UI bilesenleri tasarlama Kimleri Arıyoruz? Mikro servis mimarisi konusunda deneyimli Ölçeklenebilir ve güvenli API geliştirme konularında bilgili Event-driven mimari ve mesaj kuyruğu sistemleriyle çalışmış React.js ve Next.js teknolojileriyle frontend geliştirme deneyimine sahip Takım çalışmasına yatkın ve problem çözme yeteneği güçlü Web uygulamaları geliştirme konusunda deneyimli Git, GitHub gibi versiyon kontrol sistemlerine hâkim Gereksinimler Bilgisayar mühendisliği, Yazılım mühendisliği, Elektrik-Elektronik mühendisliği veya ilgili bölümlerden mezun En az 2 yıl yazılım geliştirme deneyimi olan İzmir ve çevresinde yaşayan Ne Sunuyoruz? Dinamik ve yenilikçi bir ekip Modern teknolojilerle çalışma fırsatı Başvurularınızı bekliyoruz! 🚀🚀🚀

title: Senior Java Backend Developer (E-Commerce)
description: ABOUT US BİM Birleşik Mağazalar A.Ş., which began operations in 1995 with 21 stores, is today the company with the highest market share in Turkey's organized retail sector. BİM's core principle is delivering essential food and consumer goods to customers at the highest quality and most competitive prices. As the first representative of the hard-discount model in Turkey, BİM offers a product range of approximately 900 items — the majority of which are its own private-label brands — through its retail stores operating across the country. In addition, BİM launched an online shopping service for non-food products via the BİM MARKET mobile application in late 2021. BİM continued its steady growth in 2024, opening 886 new domestic stores throughout the year to reach a total of 12,089 stores in Turkey by year-end. The company continues to develop while maintaining its commitment to quality and customer satisfaction alongside an effective cost management policy. About the Role We're looking for a Senior Java Backend Developer to help build and scale the core services powering our e-commerce platform. You'll take ownership of critical systems end-to-end, shape architectural decisions, and work at the intersection of high-traffic infrastructure and modern engineering practices Responsibilities Contribute to end-to-end architectural design and help shape technical standards Champion AI-assisted development culture and make it part of daily engineering workflows Develop critical services and features end-to-end and own them in production Define service boundaries, data ownership, and inter-service communication models Design and implement solutions that meet scalability and performance targets Define and implement disaster recovery (DR), security, and observability practices Work closely with product and other teams to shape technical requirements Actively participate in code reviews, upholding quality and maintainability standards Act as a technical partner on complex problems and guide the team Document technical decisions and mentor less experienced engineers to strengthen knowledge sharing and technical alignment Qualifications 8+ years of backend development experience Experience with Java 21 and the Spring Boot / Spring Cloud ecosystem Hands-on experience using AI-assisted coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) as part of daily development workflows Experience designing and running microservices in production (data modeling, API design, inter-service communication) Experience modeling complex business domains and designing bounded contexts using Domain-Driven Design (DDD) Experience with event-driven architecture and distributed data consistency using Kafka or similar messaging platforms Experience with performance tuning, migration management, and high-volume data on PostgreSQL (or similar relational databases) Experience with Redis for caching strategies, session management, and rate-limiting Experience with Elasticsearch / OpenSearch for search and filtering infrastructure Experience with container-based deployment using Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm Experience with observability practices, DR, and High Availability (HA) architecture Strong command of code quality, maintainability, test automation, and CI/CD practices Experience working on high-traffic systems (e-commerce, payments, banking, telecom, etc.) Experience with AWS services (EKS, RDS, ElastiCache, MSK, S3)
